{{Quote|There is nothing wrong with fear. You need never be ashamed of it, as long as it doesn't stop you functioning. Fear is your natural warning system; it keeps you alive so that you can fight. Show me a man who isn't afraid, and I'll show you a fool who is a danger to his entire ship. And I do not tolerate fools in my navy.|Adar Tallon|<ref name="hc">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>}}
'''Adar Tallon''' was a renowned [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] military [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] tactician and [[Navy/Legends|naval]] commander who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. A legend in his own time, Tallon devised such maneuvers as the [[Tallon Roll/Legends|Tallon Roll]] and the [[Tallon split]], and served with distinction in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], where his [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter combat]] tactics were put to good use against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Alongside [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], he fought at the [[Battle of Rendili]], which resulted in a Republic victory over the Confederacy.

When [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] declared himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] and transformed the Galactic Republic into the Empire, Tallon served the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], leading [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval forces]] against [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]]. However, he later took a stand and publicly spoke out against the new regime. But the war hero soon discovered that Palpatine was far too powerful to be defeated, and so Tallon feigned his own [[Death/Legends|death]]. Hiding on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Tallon settled down and [[Marriage/Legends|married]], and was content for two decades. But due to the betrayal of his former shipmate [[Quist (pirate)|Quist]], Tallon found himself once again the target of Palpatine's agents.

Left with little choice, Tallon joined the Rebel Alliance, and actively fought against Palpatine's New Order. Working alongside [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]], [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Walex Blissex/Legends|Walex Blissex]], and [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Jake Farrell/Legends|Jake Farrell]], he helped develop the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]]. At one point, Tallon's [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|naval]] command saw him lead Rebel forces into the [[Battle of Heterkus]]. After the Rebellion [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|developed]] into the New Republic, Tallon continued to serve, as a part of [[General/Legends|General]] Jan Dodonna's "[[Gray Cadre/Legends|Gray Cadre]]."

==Biography==
===Early years and the Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Alarm klaxon? Commander Tallon, what have we got?''"<br />"''Separatist ships have arrived to support the Rendili fleet, General!|Saesee Tiin and Adar Tallon|<ref name="Rep70">[[Republic 70|''Republic'' 70]]</ref>}}
A [[Color/Legends|black]]-haired, light-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="Star Wars: Rebellion" /> Adar Tallon was an officer in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] who was particularly adept at [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] tactics, though he also served as a [[Navy/Legends|naval]] commander. He devised several famous starfighter maneuvers,<ref name="ras">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> lending his name to the [[Tallon Roll/Legends|Tallon Roll]]<ref name="ccg">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Tallon Roll}}</ref> and [[Tallon split]].<ref name="Running the Gauntlet-GG3-2">{{WEGCite|story=Running the Gauntlet|book=Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back|reprint=1}}</ref> He became a legend in his own time, later being revered as the "Father of the Old Republic Navy."<ref name="tm" /> He became fast friends with colleagues such as [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], who would collaborate with him in his revolutionizing of space combat.<ref name="gg1">''[[Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope]]''</ref> At some stage, Tallon developed the ''[[Treatise on Starfighter Tactics/Legends|Treatise on Starfighter Tactics]]'', which expounded upon and outlined Tallon's five stages of starfighter combat. The book was carefully considered when the [[Twin Ion Engine starfighter|T.I.E. starfighter]] was designed, and became the basis for deployment of later incarnations of the craft.<ref name="air:tf:">{{JournalCite|10|Alliance Intelligence Report: TIE Fighters}}</ref> He became a celebrity amongst military personalities to the point that "fans" would have posters of him on their walls,<ref name="sosr">{{WEGCite|story=The Barani Conspiracy|book=Secrets of the Sisar Run}}</ref> and statues were constructed in his honor.<ref name="tm" /> Tallon even worked on developing and modifying starfighters themselves, as with the case of the [[Z-95t Headhunter]]. Tallon took the standard Z-95 model, fitted it with a Class 3 [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Hyperdrive]], and in the process made the craft more maneuverable. This would later prompt the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] to develop their own hyperdrive-capable Z-95.<ref name="db">{{DB|starship|z95headhunter|Z-95 Headhunter}}</ref>

[[File:Tallon_turned.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Adar Tallon served with the Jedi during the Battle of Rendili.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Tallon made a name for himself and eventually became a hero due to his exploits of the field of battle. At some stage during the war, he fought alongside the [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Alderaan]], though his more well-known exploits found him at the side of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].<ref name="tm" /> When a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] flotilla emerged in the [[Balamak system/Legends|Balamak system]] and began jamming a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] node with experimental technology, Adar Tallon was enlisted to devise a counterattack for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. With [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Nanda-Ree Janoo]] leading the attack, Tallon's plan was enacted, and the jamming was lifted, allowing HoloNet access in the [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot sector]] once more.<ref name="hnn">{{InsiderCite|65|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:2:12}}</ref> Tallon's actions led him to later be hailed as the "Victor of Balamak."<ref name="tm" />

Bearing the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]], Tallon served with a naval task force headed by Jedi Generals [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]]. Tallon was stationed aboard the flagship ''[[Sundiver]]'', which was called into action during the [[Battle of Rendili]]. When negotiations aboard the [[Rendili Home Defense Fleet]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] turned sour, General Koon and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Jan Dodonna were taken hostage by [[Mellor Yago]], along with Republic sympathizer Captain [[Jace Dallin]]. The situation remained a standoff until a Confederate force entered the system.<ref name="Rep70" />

Tallon alerted General Tiin to the danger, prompting the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] to take action. Tiin took to space in his starfighter, joining the battle personally and leaving command of the ''Sundiver'' to Tallon. As the Rendili fleet attempted to flee, Tiin ordered Tallon to engage the Home Defense Fleet flagship at close quarters, hoping to dissuade any attempts at escape. The attack allowed Jedi Knight Anakin Skywalker to disable the flagship's astronavigation system, trapping them in the system.<ref name="Rep70" /> Jedi Generals Obi-Wan Kenobi and [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] were able to liberate Koon, Dodonna and Dallin, seize control of the Rendili flagship, and turn the tides on the Confederate attackers. The battle won, the Republic now had possession of a large fleet of Rendili [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]].<ref name="Rep71">[[Republic 71|''Republic'' 71]]</ref> During his career with the navy, Tallon held the rank of [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]], in which capacity he delivered an address to the new intake of students at a Republic academy.<ref name="hc" />

===Feigning death===
{{Quote|There came a time when it became obvious that Palpatine would soon rule the galaxy. I knew that I would have to flee or die opposing him. I came here to this desolate planet far from the interests of the Empire, fell in love, and settle down to start a home.|Adar Tallon|<ref name="tm" />}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] was formed, and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] declared himself [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]].<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Tallon was concerned by the government's new policy and direction: his former allies, the Jedi, were now virtually extinct and considered enemies of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and the navy he served was now a part of Palpatine's gargantuan war machine.<ref name="tm" /> Despite his reservations, Tallon continued to serve the new regime, and he and Jan Dodonna were dispatched to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], to lead the [[Twelfth Army/Legends|Twelfth Sector Army]] in a campaign against [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]]. During what became known as the [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection]], Tallon and Dodonna engaged Confederate forces under the command of the former [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]], leading the Empire to victory at the worlds [[Diado]] and [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]]. Tallon and Dodonna subsequently pursued Toora to [[Trasemene]], where Tallon's command ship, the [[Praetor-class Star Battlecruiser/Legends|''Praetor''-class Star Battlecruiser]] [[Battalion (Praetor-class)|''Battalion'']], [[Battle of Trasemene|destroyed]] [[Defiance's Banner|Toora's flagship]], bringing the insurrection to an end.<ref name="Warfare" />

Tallon spoke out against Palpatine, but realized that the Emperor was far too powerful to be toppled. Palpatine himself paid attention to Tallon, who, being a war hero, could influence the population. In response, Tallon decided to feign his own death. He hired a medium-sized freighter to stand by in the [[Dalchon system/Legends|Dalchon system]] and enlisted his pirate friend [[Quist (pirate)|Quist]] to "[[Battle of the Dalchon system|attack]]" it while the ''Battalion'' was in the vicinity. The ''Battalion'' arrived, supposedly to help defend the freighter; Quist turned his attention to the new arrival, and Tallon and his crew safely transferred to the freighter as Quist destroyed the ''Battalion''. In accordance with Tallon's instructions, the freighter then took him to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. In the Empire, it was commonly accepted that Tallon and his crew had gone down defending helpless merchants from pirates. Even Palpatine bought the story, and believed that he didn't have to do the damaging deed of executing a popular war hero for [[Treason/Legends|treason]].<ref name="tm" /> Tallon's tactics and maneuvers would go on to be used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].<ref name="cav3">{{WEGCite|story=Tatooine Manhunt|book=Classic Adventures: Volume Three}}</ref>

On Tatooine, Adar Tallon and the ''Battalion'' crew bought new identities and settled down, waiting for the politics of the galaxy to swing once more. As the years went by, Tallon's desire to fight the Empire lessened. He found himself a [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] in [[Kay Tallon|Kay]], and a home in [[Fort Tusken/Legends|Fort Tusken]]. He employed two servants, [[Morr Wenn|Morr]] and [[Cala Wenn]], as well as a [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[LN-26]]. The spacious Fort Tusken allowed him to pursue several hobbies, such as music, and also featured a large hangar in which he kept his vehicles, including four Z-95 Headhunters.<ref name="tm" />

===Galactic Civil War===
====Joining the Rebellion====
{{Quote|And now the hiding ends.|Adar Tallon|<ref name="tm" />}}
[[File:TallonRoll-FFGTCG.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Tallon Roll in use by the Rebellion]]
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] patrols began scouring Tatooine for the droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].<ref name="nec" /> Tallon believed that the Empire had finally come to track him down, so he contacted his old ''Battalion'' crew, including [[Vytor Shrike]] and [[Jungen]], who were now bounty hunters. At any rate, Tallon was tired of hiding, and he decided to form his own army of mercenaries from his crew to fight Palpatine's Empire. Although the intent of the Imperials had been to search for the two droids, they did indeed discover that Tallon was alive. Quist had been [[Battle in the Dalchon system|captured]] by the Imperials and had exchanged information on Tallon for his life. Acting on their information, the Imperials, led by Captain [[Ranif Parlan]] of the [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']], brought in bounty hunters, as well as their own agents to [[Escape from Tatooine|track down]] the war hero.<ref name="cav3" />

Holing up in Fort Tusken with his comrades as Imperial troops and bounty hunters, as well as a small group of soldiers from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] closed in, Tallon vowed to take the battle to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] if he won on Tatooine. Quist had returned to Tallon's band, but the war hero did not realize that his former comrade was now acting as an agent of the Empire. Soon enough, a group of people Tallon believed to be Imperials were brought into Fort Tusken's music room. The group claimed to be members of the Alliance, and protested that they were sympathetic to Tallon's cause. As the war hero debated with the intruders, Quist took Kay hostage, and used the momentum to usher in his Imperial allies.<ref name="tm" />

A pack of bounty hunters swept into the room, amongst them [[Jodo Kast]], [[Zardra]] and [[Puggles Trodd/Legends|Puggles Trodd]]. Shrike and Jungen were quickly paralyzed by Kast, but the Rebels were able to beat the invaders back. Quist relinquished custody of Kay to the Rebels, on the condition that he be allowed to leave in peace. Realizing that the group were in fact Rebels, Tallon agreed to join the Alliance, provided he could bring his wife and droid along with him. Making their way through various Imperial entanglements in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], and evading capture by the ''Relentless'' over Tatooine, Tallon and his new Rebel allies were able to make it to the Alliance safely.<ref name="tm" /> In the Alliance, Tallon would serve alongside former comrades, such as [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]].<ref name="gg3">[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]]</ref>

====Tactician====
{{Quote|It is rarely given adequate attention. The inexperienced pilot frequently believes that following an attack pass, particularly a successful one, the engagement is over and he can relax. This is dangerous nonsense.|Tallon in his ''Treatise on Starfighter Tactics''|<ref name="ras" />}}
[[File:Adar_Tallon_SWArmada.png|thumb|left|300px|Tallon as a Rebel tactician]]
In his service to the Alliance, Tallon worked with both an old guard of tacticians and promising newcomers. He worked in the field with other tactical luminaries such as [[Risiev Credal]], and Tallon's influence clearly showed in Credal's later work.<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref> Tallon's own book, ''Treatise on Starfighter Tactics'', would be employed thoroughly by the Alliance when planning to battle the Empire.<ref name="ras" /> In the aftermath of the Alliance's victory in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Tallon, the Alliance admiral [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] and the starship designer [[Walex Blissex/Legends|Walex Blissex]] came to the joint decision that the Rebels required a new model of starfighter that was faster than the Alliance's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]], in order to counter some of the Empire's new [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] starfighter lines. They worked with the Alliance pilot [[Jake Farrell/Legends|Jake Farrell]] to develop some new designs, and the result of their endeavors was the [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]], a modified version of the [[R-22 Spearhead starfighter|R-22 Spearhead]] fighter. Around this time, in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Ackbar re-organized the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] to make it more centralized, but due to his reputation, Tallon retained significant influence, because it became politically impossible for him to be subordinated under Ackbar's command.<ref name="Warfare" />

Shortly after being accepted into the Alliance, Tallon took a fleet to [[Heterkus]], when an Imperial force of three [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] was laying waste to Alliance installments and and cities with suspected sympathies for the Rebellion. As soon as his forces entered the area, Tallon launched X-Wings and A-wings to [[Battle of Heterkus|engage]] the Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] that were approaching. On his flagship, the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] ''[[Silent Water]]'', Tallon watched the battle unfold as his inexperienced crew went rigorously through the battle drills. As the engagement wore on, Tallon saw an opening for an attack, having recognized the Star Destroyer ''Relentless''&mdash;a craft under the command of Imperial captain [[Westen]]. Confident in his knowledge of the ''Relentless''{{'s}} crew, Tallon ordered his [[Unidentified Rebel lieutenant (Silent Water)|helmsman]] to accelerate towards the Star Destroyer, with rear [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] shut down, and minimal starfighter cover from the rest of his fleet. He then ordered another of his staff, [[G'hengle]], to open an Imperial channel for communication with Westen, as he wanted his enemy to know whom he was fighting.<ref name="swrc">''[[The Star Wars Rules Companion]]''</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Adar Tallon found himself in the city of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]], [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], where one of his starfighter pilots had been framed by the Empire and arrested by the [[Corellian Security Force]]. Hoping to rescue his colleague, a highly-decorated Alliance pilot, Tallon enlisted the help of a wandering spacer sympathetic to the Rebellion. Tallon had designed an operation to rescue the pilot during his transfer to the [[Dathomir Imperial Prison|Imperial Prison]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Adar Tallon tasked his operative to infiltrate three different places &mdash; the [[The Warren (Dantooine)|the Warren]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], the [[Downed Blood Razor's Transport]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] and the Imperial Prison on Dathomir &mdash; to find the security override codes of the CorSec prison ship. The codes later allowed a group of Rebel operatives to get close enough to the ship carrying the pilot, a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|Corellian corvette]], to pull off a rescue operation.<ref name="SWG:AT">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Adar Tallon"}}</ref> Despite an intense fighting took place inside the corvette, the operation was a success. The pilot was spirited away, saving him from a fate of Imperial imprisonment.<ref name="SWG:CC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=heroic|Corellian Corvette}}</ref>

Tallon's name was borne by [[Target Tallon]], the extraction site of the Rebel mission "[[Operation: Shadowstrike]]" on the unexplored planet [[NCW-781]].<ref name="OSS">{{WEGCite|story=Operation: Shadowstrike (adventure)|book=Instant Adventures}}</ref>

After the [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|formation]] of the Rebel Alliance's successor state, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Tallon joined his old friend General Jan Dodonna's "[[Gray Cadre/Legends|Gray Cadre]]," together with former colleagues [[Vanden Willard/Legends|Vanden Willard]] and [[Pashna Starkiller]].<ref name="des" /> Dodonna had just been released from [[Ysanne Isard]]'s prison ship ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'', and was unable to serve as a military advisor to [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] alone.<ref name="nec" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Tallon oversaw New Republic starfighter operations during the [[Battle of Bannistar Station|capture]] of the Imperial installation [[Bannistar Station]] by the [[New Republic First Fleet]].<ref name="Warfare" /> As part of the Gray Cadre, Tallon continued to advise the New Republic on military policy, especially during the reappearance of Palpatine<ref name="des" /> in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].<ref name="nec" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Tallons_Family_Crest.svg|thumb|right|100px|Tallon's family crest]]
Adar Tallon always believed he was serving justice when fighting for the Republic. He voiced his ideals and beliefs strongly when he became, essentially, a celebrity.<ref name="tm" /> He would not suffer the antics of brash and reckless fools under his command,<ref name="hc" /> and he served his superiors efficiently and without question.<ref name="Rep70" /> Despite severe repercussions for those who spoke out against Palpatine and his Empire, Tallon did not hesitate, though it would eventually cost him his liberty. As time went by, Tallon became less patriotic and more content with his home life, but when hunted by Palpatine's agents, the war hero took an active role in the fight against the Emperor.<ref name="tm" /> He also cared enough about his men to personally aid in rescuing them.<ref name="SWG:AT" /> He was skilled, as well, in the modification of starships&mdash;so much so that corporations would later follow his examples.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
Adar Tallon first appeared in ''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]'', a [[1988]] adventure written for [[West End Games]]'s ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[Bill Slavicsek]] and [[Daniel Greenberg]]. While precise details of the adventure are determined by player choice, the campaign suggests that Rebel agents (the player characters) helped Tallon's associates rescue Tallon from Jodo Kast and the other bounty hunters.<ref name="tm" />

Tallon was first visually depicted in the [[1998]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']], in which he is the Alliance equivalent of the Empire's [[Bevel Lemelisk]], being able to research in all three fields of technology: ship design, troop training, and facility design. His combat and espionage skills are low, and his leadership abilities are average.<ref name="Star Wars: Rebellion" />
